scene_analysis.scene_overview: A sunny day in a park with a large cathedral in the distance, surrounded by trees and buildings. The sky is blue with some white clouds. There are several people walking around, and there are also some bicycles parked along the sidewalk. The ground is paved with concrete and has a few benches and trash cans scattered throughout. There are also some trees and bushes along the sidewalk, as well as a few streetlights. In the background, there is a large cathedral with tall spires and intricate architecture. The cathedral is made of stone and has a grand entrance with columns and arches. The surrounding area is relatively quiet, with only a few people walking around. Overall, the scene appears peaceful and serene.
